dataset: CivicIntel — The Politics of Sugar: evidence-backed seed network
scope: Documented U.S. sugar policy institutional and economic relationships; mainly 2025-2027 with historical 2014 context
caveats: Contains actor nodes AND context nodes (documents/policies/affected groups). Do not interpret document-centered graph centrality as political power.
Reported lobbying issues and named agencies do not prove contact with specific elected officials, improper influence, or causality.
Marketing allocations are permitted sales volumes, not cash payments, subsidies received, profits, or economic benefits.
Only a curated subset of the 29 May 2026 letter endorsers appears. No inference should be made from omitted endorsements.
GAO incidence figures are estimates in studies reviewed in 2023, not contemporary audited cash flows.
USDA FY2027 published processor rows sum to 10,574,851 STRV, one STRV above its stated total of 10,574,850; no values have been altered.
Relationships are snapshots tied to their cited dates, not assertions that roles or ties are permanent.
